meta.method: NDVI=(B08−B04)/(B08+B04) at 20 m; SCL classes 4–7 kept; vegetated = NDVI ≥ 0.4; compared only where both scenes are clear
meta.caveat: Scenes are 2025-11-15 and 2026-11-17: both fully clear over campus and 2 days apart in the calendar, so season explains little; mowing, crops or works can still show as change.
